moments.title: The Hundred Cricket Continues

angles.name: Daily Fixtures
angles.copy: Catch all the action! The Hundred cricket tournament is delivering thrilling matches across the UK daily. Who are you backing for the win?

angles.name: Welsh Fire Focus

moments.title: UK Singles Chart Update: Sam Fender & Ariana Grande
moments.blurb: The latest Official UK Singles Chart update, covering August 2-8, shows Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' poised for a historic 20th week at Number 1, while Ariana Grande's new album 'petal' makes a strong chart impact.

angles.name: Longest No.1 Reign
angles.copy: History in the making! Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is on track for an incredible 20th week at UK Number 1. Is it the greatest chart reign ever?

angles.name: Ariana Grande Album Impact
angles.copy: Ariana Grande's new album 'petal' is dominating the chart update! Tracks like 'petal' (No.3) and 'kiss me' (No.6) are making a huge splash. Which is your favourite?

angles.name: New Dance Banger
angles.copy: Keep an eye on the charts! HUGEL's 'Movin' To The Sun' is set to break the Top 5, and Silva Bumpa's 'On 2nite' is eyeing the Top 10. Perfect for your summer playlist!

moments.title: Roots Picnic Festival Lands in London
moments.blurb: The acclaimed Roots Picnic festival makes its international debut at Crystal Palace Bowl, London, on August 8th and 9th, bringing its unique blend of hip hop, R&B, and culture to the UK.

angles.name: UK Debut
angles.copy: London, get ready! The legendary Roots Picnic festival is making its international debut this weekend at Crystal Palace Bowl. Who are you excited to see live?

angles.name: Weekend Vibes
angles.copy: Crystal Palace Bowl is heating up! The Roots Picnic brings two days of incredible hip hop, R&B, and cultural celebration this weekend. Don't miss out!

moments.title: Haverfordwest Carnival Returns
moments.blurb: Haverfordwest Carnival is set to return on Saturday, August 15th, promising Pembrokeshire's biggest family day out with floats, entertainment, and community spirit.

angles.name: Family Fun
angles.copy: Get ready, Pembrokeshire! Haverfordwest Carnival is back on Saturday, August 15th, for a fantastic day of family fun. Who's entering a float this year?

angles.name: Community Event
angles.copy: Mark your calendars! The biggest event in Haverfordwest is just over a week away. Join the carnival on August 15th for a celebration of community and creativity!

moments.title: New British Dramas on BritBox
moments.blurb: BritBox is set to premiere several new British dramas this month, including the historical period drama 'The Hardacres, Seasons 1-2' on August 5th and the cruise ship crime series 'The Good Ship Murder, Season 1-3' on August 10th.

angles.name: Historical Drama Fix
angles.copy: Love a good period drama? 'The Hardacres' (Seasons 1-2) arrives on BritBox tomorrow, August 5th, following a working-class family's rise in 1890s Yorkshire!

angles.name: New Crime Series
angles.copy: Fancy a whodunit on the high seas? 'The Good Ship Murder' (Seasons 1-3) docks on BritBox on August 10th. Perfect for your next binge-watch!

angles.name: Community Action
angles.copy: The health of Wales' rivers needs our attention! A new WWF Cymru campaign, fronted by Mirain Iwerydd James, is calling for urgent action. How can you get involved?
